title: Animation states
description: How a character picks and blends the clips of an animation set in game (backlog M1-24, game/client/character_animator.gd). The id names the animation set (data/animations/<id>.json) whose clips it uses.

clip.description: A clip of the animation set

priority.description: A new action replaces a playing one of lower priority at once, of equal priority after min_s

min_s.description: Shortest time this action plays before one of equal priority replaces it

blend_smoothing_s.description: Time constant of the locomotion blend position following the velocity

stand_s.description: Idle to combat idle and back

action_in_s.description: Action layer fading in over locomotion

action_out_s.description: Action layer fading back to locomotion

action_xfade_s.description: Cross-fade from one action clip to the next

full_body_s.description: Legs joining or leaving an action as the character stops or starts moving

override_in_s.description: Crowd control, death or victory taking over

directions.description: Moving clips at their points of the 2D blend space: x is right, y is forward, in units of the direction's full ground speed

moving_min_mps.description: Ground speed below which the character stands

teleport_min_mps.description: Apparent speeds above this are blinks or corrections, not movement

speed_scale.description: Playback speed of the moving clips follows ground speed / full speed, within these limits

combat.description: In combat (combat idle) = casting, a living hostile target within range, or damage dealt or taken recently

body_split.description: Bones of the upper body (actions play here while moving) and of the legs (join the action when standing)

cast.description: Cast-time abilities: start then loop while the cast bar runs; the release plays on success

release.description: by_school: play <clip>_<ability school> when the set has it

melee.description: Melee swings cycle through these clips; the cycle restarts after reset_s without a swing

hit.description: Hit reaction on damage of at least min_damage_pct of maximum health, at most once per cooldown_s

ability_rules.description: Which action an ability plays: the first rule whose conditions all hold. The last rule must have no conditions, so every ability resolves

effect.description: Any of the ability's effects has one of these types

range.description: melee: range up to tuning ranges.melee_m (above 0); ranged: beyond it

ability_overrides.description: Ability id -> action, ahead of the rules

crowd_control.description: Crowd-control category (auras' cc_category) -> clip that overrides everything while it lasts

rig_modifiers.description: Runtime polish from Godot's skeleton modifiers on top of the clips (backlog X-02, game/client/rig_modifiers.gd). Either section may be left out to skip it

look_at.description: Head, neck and chest turn toward the target (its position plus target_height_m), else ahead leaning into the movement. The look direction is limited to max_yaw/pitch around the body's facing; a target more than give_up_deg to the side is ignored (look ahead)

bones.description: One LookAtModifier3D per bone, parents first, each turning its bone by its share of what remains toward the look direction, within its own limits (degrees either side of the animated pose). The last bone is the head: the look starts at its position

target_height_m.description: Look at this height above the target's feet (about head height)

min_target_distance_m.description: A target closer than this (ground distance from the eyes) is not looked at

marker_distance_m.description: The look marker sits this far from the head along the eased look direction

turn_s.description: Time constant of the look direction following its goal (no neck snapping)

blend_in_s.description: Look-at fading back in after a suppressing clip

blend_out_s.description: Look-at fading out when a suppressing clip starts

moving.description: Without a target, the look turns this share of the way toward the direction of movement when it is within max_deg of the facing (strafes yes, backpedal no)

suppress.description: While the override or action layer plays one of these clips, the look-at blends to 0 (it would fight the animation)

foot_ik.description: Feet on the actual floor: a ray down at each animated ankle measures the floor against the character's origin; the pelvis lowers for the lower foot and TwoBoneIK3D bends each leg to its offset. Level floors give offsets of 0, and then nothing runs

ground_layers.description: Physics layers the foot rays hit (1 = world)

ray_up_m.description: Rays start this far above the origin's floor level

ray_down_m.description: and end this far below it

dead_zone_m.description: Floor offsets smaller than this count as level

smoothing_s.description: Time constant of each foot's offset following the floor

slope_tilt_max_deg.description: Feet tilt to the floor's slope up to this angle

blend_s.description: Grounding fading in on landing and out on take-off or a suppressing clip

foot_lock.description: Standing still, the feet hold their place and rotation while the body turns; past max_slide_m or max_turn_deg the foot farthest off lets go and eases back to its animated place over release_s, one foot at a time

suppress.description: While the override or action layer plays one of these clips, grounding blends to 0
